name_reason: Name already correct: prefix data_fd2_battle_ matches a battle core table; descriptor combat_speech_bubble_pos_pairs reflects both purpose (combat-intro 'vs' speech-bubble cinematic) and data structure (an array of (x,y) position pairs). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own/any address). Domain semantics preserved (no spurious ID suffix to strip).
purpose: Runtime scratch holding two on-screen (x,y) pixel-position pairs for the combat-intro 'vs' speech-bubble cinematic: [0..1]=attacker bubble, [2..3]=counter-attacker bubble.
logic_summary: Filled then consumed by the sole accessor fd2_animate_combat_speech_bubbles (@0x1EB05). It calls fd2_compute_combat_bubble_screen_pos(&pairs[0], defender_idx) to place the attacker bubble; if a counter is possible it calls the same helper on &pairs[2] (attacker_idx), else stores pairs[2] = -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) as the no-counter sentinel. The 10-frame fade-in then blits a portrait-sheet sprite at (pairs[0],pairs[1]) and, when pairs[2] != -1, at (pairs[2],pairs[3]). The writer fd2_compute_combat_bubble_screen_pos derives tile->pixel coordinates and clamps them to the 320x200 screen with signed arithmetic.
element_semantics: Four signed int32 forming two (x,y) screen-pixel pairs: [0]=attacker bubble x, [1]=attacker bubble y, [2]=counter-attacker bubble x, [3]=counter-attacker bubble y. [2] == -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) is the no-counter sentinel.
notes: Type evidence: every access is a whole dword (PUSH/MOV dword ptr) at strides of 4 (0x53A30/34/38/3C) -> 4-byte element, exactly 4 elements (16 bytes). Signed: writer does signed coordinate arithmetic (iVar1 < 0; -1 < x-0x56) and the no-counter sentinel is tested signed (CMP dword[0x53A38],-1). Non-const justified by game-side writes: direct WRITE of -1 at 0x1eb4c plus indirect writes via the &pairs[0]/&pairs[2] pointers passed to fd2_compute_combat_bubble_screen_pos; memory is all-zero .bss, written before read, so static contents are don't-care. src comment (btltab2.c lines 216-243) already precise and accurate -> kept, src file untouched. Ghidra data plate at 0x53A30 was empty (null) -> created via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT, content consistent with src conclusion. No logic/equivalence issues found.
